faqs.q: How do I activate Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?
faqs.a: Navigate to Profile > Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Scan the QR code using any standard authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password) and save your 10 backup codes.

faqs.q: What are the requirements for Creator Profile Verification?
faqs.a: Creators with at least 1,000 active followers and an original 3D portfolio can apply for verification by submitting their portfolio links and identity verification documents.

faqs.q: How do I request an export of my personal data under GDPR?
faqs.a: Go to Privacy Settings > Export Data Archive. Our systems will compile your profile, posts, and interaction history into an encrypted JSON/CSV archive within 24 hours.

faqs.q: What 3D formats are supported by VessertID Engine?
faqs.a: VessertID natively supports glTF 2.0 binary (.glb) and JSON (.gltf) with support for KHR_materials_unlit, KHR_texture_transform, and KHR_draco_mesh_compression.

faqs.q: What are recommended polygon limits for mobile devices?
faqs.a: For smooth 60 FPS mobile playback, we recommend keeping models under 150,000 triangles, atlas textures capped at 2048x2048 (KTX2/WebP), and file sizes under 25 MB.

faqs.q: How can I apply custom fragment shaders to my reels?
faqs.a: Pro creators can open the Shader Studio in the web workspace, write GLSL vertex/fragment shaders, link uniforms (time, resolution, audio reactive bands), and attach them to any 3D reel.

faqs.q: What payment methods are supported globally?
faqs.a: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Stripe, and regional digital wallets.

faqs.q: How does creator revenue sharing work for virtual gifts?
faqs.a: Creators receive 70% of the net value of virtual coins gifted during live streams or on 3D reels. Payouts are processed monthly via Stripe Connect or wire transfer.
